purpose: Distinguishes which of the 26 legacy FEATURE_COLUMNS are valid inputs for new modeling work from which are deprecated legacy/placeholder fields, without altering any released candidate-row values. This schema governs NEW baselines and NEW model training only; release/lafc-evict-v1.0's Parquet files are unchanged.

valid_model_features.name: candidate_recency_rank
valid_model_features.reason: Non-constant (256 distinct values); pure function of within-decision recency order, available at decision time.

valid_model_features.name: candidate_age_norm
valid_model_features.reason: Non-constant (472 distinct values); normalized recency_rank, available at decision time.

valid_model_features.name: candidate_lru_score
valid_model_features.reason: Non-constant (472 distinct values); pure function of within-decision recency order, available at decision time.

valid_model_features.name: candidate_is_lru_victim
valid_model_features.reason: Non-constant (2 distinct values); argmax of candidate_lru_score, available at decision time.

valid_model_features.name: score_gap_to_lru_victim
valid_model_features.reason: Non-constant (472 distinct values); verified exact deterministic transform of candidate_lru_score (gap to the same decision's best LRU score); legitimate within-decision normalization, not leakage.

valid_model_features.name: recent_candidate_request_rate
valid_model_features.reason: Non-constant (159 distinct values); rolling window over already-elapsed request history.

valid_model_features.name: recent_candidate_hit_rate
valid_model_features.reason: Non-constant (285 distinct values); rolling window over already-elapsed hit history.

rules.data_values_unchanged: This schema does not alter any value in release/lafc-evict-v1.0 or any prior release. Deprecated columns remain present in the released Parquet files for provenance/reproducibility; they are simply excluded from scripts/validate_model_features.py's allowed input list for new baselines.
